lina: spotted p99 spike on /v1/generate at ~08:02 UTC. p50 steady, p95 small, p99 +100ms. possibly related to routing/queue changes?
mike: we adjusted routing weights EU->dedicated yesterday. unlikely to only affect p99.
sangeet: share slice?
lina: slice shows mobile-ios + high-priority queue concentrated.
ops-bot: autoscaler event 07:58 UTC scaled +2 in eu-west-1.

mike: hypothesis: dashboard metric mixes gateway queue_time into service_time in some rollups.
devx: UX quick fix: add "include queue time" toggle (default off) and a legend showing which metric is used.
sangeet: infra will add sample_origin and queue_time_ms to samples; PR today.
lina: short actions: 1) sangeet add telemetry fields; 2) mike make dashboard default to backend_proc_ms and add legend; 3) devx mock toggle; 4) ops add runbook check for queue_time histogram when p99 spikes.
mike: will post backend_vs_gateway p99 numbers once I pull raw samples.
lin a: thanks everyone, marking follow-up on Console UX board. :thumbsup:
